purpose: Document model families that may extend language coverage while preserving the single app interface and legal gates.

candidates.architecture: T5 translation model with target language prefix
requirements: verify upstream revision and original license; inspect training-data license and intended use
audit claimed native codes against Glottolog IDs and script codes
measure CPU RAM and streaming caption latency; 3B may be too slow on local laptop
compare independent bilingual meaning accuracy and rare-language harm
enable only with new pinned backend and rollback policy
Do not blend these weights or outputs into commercial BridgeCaption training ancestry.
Do not activate or use as commercially cleared speech/translation provider.

disclaimer: These are research leads, NOT loaded/downloaded/trained/verified backends. Future expansion requires resource, rights and quality tests; 8k documented language labels are not 8k translated languages.
